collectible:1.text: Artifacts are one of the four categories of collectible that appear in The Last of Us on PS3 and its Remastered edition on the PS4. They are also the only category of collectibles obtained in the associated DLC, Left Behind. Artifacts return as one of four collectible categories in The Last of Us Part II.

collectible:3.text: Comics are one of the four categories of collectibles in The Last of Us. The comics are issues of a fictional, in-universe series called Savage Starlight created by Newman Oeming Rosenberg, about a futuristic sci-fi adventure. In total, there are 14 issues to collect.
